text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having woken up early, I take my time heading to the academy so as to enjoy all I can of the fresh morning air.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer. Isn't the weather beautiful this morning?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. I had a relaxing day yesterday. Or maybe it's because of the nice dream I had last night…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well, in the dream, I was the wind, blowing across a huge plain…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My body was as light as air, and I could fly for as long and as far as I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I bet I can run like the wind today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka appears fully revitalized and brimming with drive and energy.
